equal_rate_diagnostic.rationale: 100 Hz is an integer divisor of the 1000 Hz plant, is supported by every direct-wrench and adapter stack, exceeds the historical 20 Hz outer bandwidth, and leaves a 10 ms compute deadline.

deadline_rule: each component update is a miss iff wall-clock compute time exceeds its own preregistered period; report count/rate plus mean/P95/P99/max
